pages.quiz:
GRADE 6 CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About String Musical Instruments and Drawing at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify string instruments from different indigenous communities in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore String Musical Instruments and Drawing completely.
   C. String Musical Instruments and Drawing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

2. About String Musical Instruments and Drawing at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the functions of the parts of a string instrument,
   B. Learners should ignore String Musical Instruments and Drawing completely.
   C. String Musical Instruments and Drawing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

3. About String Musical Instruments and Drawing when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. make a fiddle using recyclable materials,
   B. Learners should ignore String Musical Instruments and Drawing completely.
   C. String Musical Instruments and Drawing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

5. About Painting and Collage at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. classify colour categories on the colour wheel for familiarity,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Collage completely.
   C. Painting and Collage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Collage.

6. About Painting and Collage at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. paint a still life composition using brush stroke technique,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Collage completely.
   C. Painting and Collage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Collage.

7. About Painting and Collage when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. mount the painting using mat technique for display,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Collage completely.
   C. Painting and Collage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Collage.

9. About Volleyball at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the serving and the digging skills in Volleyball,
   B. Learners should ignore Volleyball completely.
   C. Volleyball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volleyball.

10. About Volleyball at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform under-arm service for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Volleyball completely.
   C. Volleyball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volleyball.

11. About Volleyball when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute single hand dig pass in volleyball for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Volleyball completely.
   C. Volleyball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volleyball.

13. About Rhythm and Pattern Making at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret rhythmic patterns in music,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm and Pattern Making completely.
   C. Rhythm and Pattern Making is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm and Pattern Making.

14. About Rhythm and Pattern Making at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a rhythm using a combination of musical notes and their rests,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm and Pattern Making completely.
   C. Rhythm and Pattern Making is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm and Pattern Making.

15. About Rhythm and Pattern Making when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. improvise a rhythm in three- beat pattern on a percussion instrument,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm and Pattern Making completely.
   C. Rhythm and Pattern Making is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm and Pattern Making.

17. About Weaving at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify a plain weave for familiarity,
   B. Learners should ignore Weaving completely.
   C. Weaving is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weaving.

18. About Weaving at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. prepare materials and tools for weaving,
   B. Learners should ignore Weaving completely.
   C. Weaving is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weaving.

19. About Weaving when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. weave a mat using plain weave on a serrated card loom,
   B. Learners should ignore Weaving completely.
   C. Weaving is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weaving.

21. About Gymnastics at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

22. About Gymnastics at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

23. About Gymnastics when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

25. About Melody at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. sing the sol-fa syllables doh to doh1 ascending and descending,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

26. About Melody at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the sol-fa ladder using Kodaly hand signs,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

27. About Melody when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. aurally recognise sol-fa sounds doh to doh1 in familiar melodies,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

29. About Athletics at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe Long jump and High jump techniques in athletics,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

30. About Athletics at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the sail technique in Long jump for skills acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

31. About Athletics when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the scissors technique in High jump for skills acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

33. About Descant Recorder at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. play notes C to D1 on the descant recorder with appropriate playing techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

34. About Descant Recorder at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. play a melody within the range of C to D1on the descant recorder,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

35. About Descant Recorder when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. play the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem on the descant recorder,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

37. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

38. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

39. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. play a selected instrument in an ensemble using appropriate techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use String Musical Instruments and Drawing at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Painting and Collage at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Volleyball at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Rhythm and Pattern Making at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Weaving at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Gymnastics at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Melody at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Athletics at home with your family.

36. Give two examples of how you can use Descant Recorder at home with your family.

40. Give two examples of how you can use Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at home with your family.
